notes: M(n) = n-2 when 3|n or 4|n (Monsky 1989; Williams arXiv:2404.18237 Thm 6). NT_C18_4.modular_queens_eq proves both bounds in Lean: queens_lower via Williams' five residue families (all m), queens_upper via Monsky's sum/sum-of-squares argument (ZMod n, lifts mod 2n). Outside Lean: none beyond reading M(n) as the maximum size of a non-attacking set.

sources.cite: P. Monsky, Solution to E3162, Amer. Math. Monthly 96 (1989) 258-259
